description: This file contains functional test cases for the AccountController's SignIn-related actions within an ASP.NET Core web application. It uses Xunit for testing HTTP responses, token validation, and form submission workflows.

classes.name: AccountControllerSignIn
classes.description: A test class implementing various tests for the account sign-in workflow, including login page access, token validation, sign-in submission, and profile update interactions.

methods.name: ReturnsSignInScreenOnGet
methods.description: Tests that a GET request to the login page successfully returns the sign-in screen containing the expected email.

methods.name: RegexMatchesValidRequestVerificationToken
methods.description: Validates that the regex correctly captures the request verification token from an HTML input snippet.

methods.name: ReturnsFormWithRequestVerificationToken
methods.description: Checks that the login page contains a valid request verification token.

methods.name: ReturnsSuccessfulSignInOnPostWithValidCredentials
methods.description: Simulates a login POST with valid credentials and verifies redirection to the home page.

methods.name: UpdatePhoneNumberProfile
methods.description: Performs a login, navigates to the profile page, updates the phone number, and verifies the update.
